failing_tests.detail: In full multi-file pytest runs, conftest.py's _clear_transient_local_modules() and _remove_service_import_roots() purge non-stable transient modules from sys.modules and strip service directories from sys.path between test modules. Because services.deployment.service is under the stable 'services' package prefix, it remained cached in sys.modules, so subsequent imports in test_deployment_owner_read_auth_boundary_with_default_bff_consumer did not re-execute services/deployment/service.py (which dynamically appends services/control-plane/governance to sys.path). Consequently, deployment_plan was not findable on sys.path.
